title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF and Burkina Faso&39;s government improved education quality, increasing child-friendly schools by 16% to 3,420 (from 2,965 in 2023) covering nearly 40% of primary schools. The Back-to-School campaign reached 196,858 children with school materials and educational messages, demonstrating progress in accessible, high-quality education nationwide.
